user.title: Create Notification Catalog
user.description: A catalog sends all of its notification rules to one fixed set of Inovelli devices.

targets.title: Choose Inovelli Devices
targets.description: Select the physical Inovelli switches whose LED bars should show this catalog. If these exact devices also belong to a Zigbee2MQTT group, enter that group's friendly name to use native Zigbee groupcasts.

init.title: Notify Lights
init.description: The Inovelli devices answer **where** a notification appears. Notification rules answer **when** it appears and **what** it looks like.

edit_targets.title: Edit Inovelli Devices
edit_targets.description: Changing these devices updates every notification rule in this catalog. Existing group-light selections are expanded into their physical Inovelli members. A Zigbee2MQTT group must contain exactly the same devices selected here.

add_notification.title: Add Notification Rule
add_notification.description: Choose a plain-language activation behavior. Automatic rules can follow a state for as long as it is true, or start a timed notification when that state is entered.

modify_notification_form.title: Edit Notification Rule
modify_notification_form.description: Renaming changes the display name only; the entity ID remains stable.

notification_source.title: Choose the State Source
notification_source.description: Select the Home Assistant entity that represents this condition. Next you'll choose its main state or a specific attribute, such as a climate entity's hvac_action.

notification_property.title: Choose What to Watch
notification_property.description: Watch the entity's main state, or choose one of its attributes. Current values are shown to make the choice understandable without looking in Developer Tools.

notification_details.title: Style the Notification
notification_details.description: Choose the LED appearance. Higher-priority notifications win when several are active on the same switch. Priority 30 or lower always has a one-pixel footprint in the stack, regardless of the selected coverage.

error.name_exists: A record with this name already exists.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name containing at least one letter or number.
error.target_required: Choose at least one Inovelli device.
